themes.title: Dracula
themes.source: theme/dracula.json as built into dracula.vsix, the v2.24.3 release

ui.faint.from: disabledForeground: VS Code's default for a dark theme

editor.cursor.from: editorCursor.foreground: VS Code's default for a dark theme

themes.title: Alucard
themes.source: theme/dracula.json as built into dracula.vsix, the v2.24.3 release, read as a light theme with each color replaced by its Alucard counterpart in the Dracula spec (https://draculatheme.com/spec)

ui.faint.from: disabledForeground: VS Code's default for a light theme

editor.cursor.from: editorCursor.foreground: VS Code's default for a light theme

syntax.keyword.from: token keyword (for keyword.control), Dracula's #ff79c6 as Alucard's

syntax.atom.from: token constant (for constant.language), Dracula's #bd93f9 as Alucard's

syntax.literal.from: token constant (for constant.numeric), Dracula's #bd93f9 as Alucard's

syntax.string.from: token string (for string.quoted), Dracula's #f1fa8c as Alucard's

syntax.regexp.from: token string.regexp (for string.regexp), Dracula's #f1fa8c as Alucard's

syntax.definition.from: token entity.name.function (for entity.name.function), Dracula's #50fa7b as Alucard's

syntax.local.from: token variable.parameter (for variable.parameter), Dracula's #ffb86c as Alucard's

syntax.type.from: token entity.name.type (for entity.name.type), Dracula's #8be9fd as Alucard's

syntax.class.from: token entity.name.class (for entity.name.class), Dracula's #8be9fd as Alucard's

syntax.macro.from: token entity.name.function (for entity.name.function.preprocessor), Dracula's #50fa7b as Alucard's

syntax.property.from: token variable (for variable.other.property), Dracula's #f8f8f2 as Alucard's

syntax.comment.from: token comment (for comment.line), Dracula's #6272a4 as Alucard's

syntax.meta.from: token storage (for storage.type.annotation), Dracula's #ff79c6 as Alucard's

syntax.invalid.from: token invalid (for invalid), Dracula's #ff5555 as Alucard's
